limitations: Observed records only. This report does not establish radio tolerance, coverage, or flight performance.

aggregation.delay_population: one sample per received record with shared-clock age, including repeated logical identities
aggregation.quantile_method: sorted empirical samples with linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; descriptive, not population-tail estimates
aggregation.rssi_population: one sample per record with supplied RSSI, including repeated logical identities
aggregation.weighting: equal weight per observed record; routes and capture conditions are pooled

summary.evidence_boundary: observed trace summary; not radio tolerance or flight performance

packets.censoring: not inferred; unknown reasons alone do not establish censoring time or mechanism
packets.denominator_contract: one record per observed transmission attempt; repeated logical identities remain separate records; unlogged attempts are not inferred

loss_rate_bounds.interpretation: identification bounds over observed records; not confidence intervals

provenance.source: checked-in example; not a hardware capture
